description:
Move the newest backup artifacts (`<db>-*.sql.gz` + `<db>-filestore-*.tar.gz`) from
    `source_host` to `target_host`, relayed through this agent's host (works even when the
    two servers can't reach each other). Run `backup_run` on the source first. dry_run
    shows what it would move. On confirm it copies both files to `backup_dir` on the target
    (created if missing) and returns their target paths - feed them straight to
    `restore_to_prod`. Read-only on the source (just reads + copies out).
name: migrate_transfer
